mapper.select: SELECT request_id,thread_id,turn_id,tool_call_id,plan_revision_id,run_id,goal_id,idempotency_key, questions_json,status,answers_json,revision,created_at,updated_at FROM interaction_requests WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT thread_id,request_id,answers_json,page,collapsed,idempotency_key,revision,updated_at FROM interaction_drafts WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interaction_drafts(thread_id,request_id,answers_json,page,collapsed,idempotency_key,revision,updated_at) VALUES(#{threadId},#{requestId},#{answersJson},#{page},#{collapsed},#{idempotencyKey},#{expectedRevision}+1,#{occurredAt}) ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO UPDATE SET answers_json=excluded.answers_json,page=excluded.page, collapsed=excluded.collapsed,idempotency_key=excluded.idempotency_key,revision=excluded.revision, updated_at=excluded.updated_at WHERE interaction_drafts.revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(event_sequence) FROM interaction_events WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
